title: I miss the old her... Why did they make her "nicer" looking???

posts.author: Lionbarrel
posts.body:
Now, I wouldn't be surprised if I'm the only one who cares, but Michelle from "RPG Maker Unite" had her character redesigned for a more appealing/kinder looking female side-kick or lead, depending on what kind of RPG maker dev you are...
Old left   New right
Note I'm very late to bringing up this subject as I haven't even realized I was able to buy just the portraits of all these characters until now
But I liked her mean original look in this friendlier version of her is not my cup of tea. Don't get me wrong, I don't think any female lead should be forced to be the sassier companion, but we don't have numerous girlies with attitudes that aren't immediately or close to being some kind of villain... I just like her original look. I am clearly the animal crossing lover who likes her villagers to be throwing insults at them...
Likewise, I may want to add that I do like conserving a lot of the RPG maker games sprites/tile sheet/asset/etc, and I don't like that you're unable to even get the original sprite anymore as they have entirely changed her.

It's considered poor forum etiquette (and is against this forum's rules) to have multiple of your own posts in a row in quick succession (in your thread, or in any thread). gstv87 said:
if this was a production anime, the new version is simpler and easier to draw: no lines on the skirt and top to be drawn at each step, and a simpler palette (mostly yellow, not so much red)
the *long featured ponytail* of the old version could simply become *a ponytail* in the newest: one has character, the other hasn't.
Click to expand...
Agreed, though I would like to point out a lot of the other characters who have similar problems of having overcomplicated styles, which is not much of a problem since they're not going to be animated are also not changed in any way. Maybe there is an outcry that I didn't see or was not participating in where they didn't like what she looked like; again I would like to iterate that I generally don't have much of a problem with the newer style, but I would also like to have the older one come in the bundle where you purchase the newer looking one with it.
I want my mean girlie back.
